description: Astra camera ablation, arm first_person: six mazes rendered by the 3D backend, camera first_person.
_note_arms: Arms differ ONLY by the render block. Model settings match the R1-frontier Astra run (run_config.r1_frontier.json) except spend_cap_usd, a per-process hard stop sized to one arm: $6 x 5 arms = the $30 budget. 3D resolution 'grid' = 32 px per cell, so a 3D frame costs the same image tokens as the 2D anchor (~100 for an 8x8). Run arms in this order so a cap stop loses the least: 2d, top_down, first_person, chase, fixed_angled. Every 3D view carries a compass; the 2D anchor does not (it is MiniGrid's own frame, as R1 played it).
_note_no_conditions: No conditions key => the single default cell from the experiment_config overlay.
